'''''Gladiolus cardinalis''''', commonly called the '''waterfall lily''', is a species of [[Corm|cormous]] flowering plant endemic to the Western Cape in [[South Africa]].<ref name=sanbi>{{Cite web |title=Threatened Species Programme {{!}} SANBI Red List of South African Plants |url=https://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1549-31}}</ref>

It's also called the '''New Year lily''' ({{Lang-xx|af|Nuwejaarsblom}} in Afrikaans) and '''cardinal red sword lily'''.

== Range and habitat ==
''Gladiolus cardinalis'' is found on the side of waterfalls in the south-western mountains of the [[Western Cape]].<ref name="sanbi" />
